title: Grays as biological drones

tellings.quote: these grays cuz that's what he said. They were these grays um seem to be these biological drones.

plain: A YouTuber named Chris Ramsay tells podcast host Jesse Michels about an anonymous poster on 4chan, an anonymous online message board, who in early 2023 claimed to be a whistleblower. Ramsay says the poster described the grays, the small gray-skinned beings of many alien reports, as biological drones. If true, the grays would be built tools rather than the beings in charge.
